creations.title: ACE Wind Now
creations.creator: charlie9578
creations.summary: A calm community turbine card showing instantaneous power and wind speed from the one-second feed, with a timestamp and clear stale or unavailable states.
creations.imageAlt: ACE Wind Now card with a green turbine illustration, live power in kW and wind speed in m/s from the one-second feed, a recent-reading badge, and the oldest signal observation time.
creations.dataUse: Uses ACE wec-1 wec_instantaneous latest 1s power and wind speed; refreshes every second; marks signal observations over one minute old stale and retains the last reading if the API is unavailable.

creations.title: Turbine Vortex
creations.creator: charlie9578
creations.summary: Learn to read the turbine in a living tunnel: wind sets the pace, power colours and fills the light, RPM twists it, and wind-vane angle bends its path. Layers remember recent conditions as they travel past you.
creations.imageAlt: Turbine Vortex with a glowing wind-steered tunnel, four measured signals including signed wind-vane angle, and a Read the wind guide showing fixed wind-speed and power colour scales.
creations.dataUse: Uses ACE wec-1 instantaneous 1s rotor speed, wind speed, power and wind-vane angle together every two seconds; fixed main meanings with five-minute adaptive detail; rests with labelled readings after 60 seconds or failures.
